blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Rain or Shine secured the No. 2 spot in Group B and a quarterfinal date with Converge after blowing out Phoenix, 133-103, in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Friday at Ynares Center here. Jhonard Clarito registered conference-highs of 18 points and 11 rebounds on top of five assists, but it was the Elasto Painters’ collective hot shooting that fuel their convincing win to close out the group stage.
